examples.japanese: 明日は雨が降るそうだ。
examples.reading: あしたはあめがふるそうだ。
examples.gloss: I hear it will rain tomorrow.

examples.japanese: 彼は先月、日本に来たそうだ。
examples.reading: かれはせんげつ、にほんにきたそうだ。
examples.gloss: I hear he came to Japan last month.

examples.japanese: あの店はおいしくないそうだ。
examples.reading: あのみせはおいしくないそうだ。
examples.gloss: I hear that shop is not good.

usage: Reports information you heard. It attaches to the plain form, including the past and negative.
It does not conjugate: there is no そうだった as hearsay.
For appearance based on what you see, use そう on the stem.

compare.difference: そう on the stem is your own impression. そうだ on a plain form is hearsay.
らしい is a judgement that may include hearsay. そうだ only reports.
